pipeline.title: ESXI
pipeline.description: VMware/vSphere extraction. Fills vmware_app from application_name when set (vCenter), else parses the leading syslog tag (ESXi hosts: Hostd, snmpd, Vpxa, vmkernel, etc.)

rules.title: vmware app from application_name
rules.description: vCenter messages already have application_name extracted by Graylog. Copy to vmware_app for unified dashboard use.
rules.source:
rule "vmware app from application_name"
when
  has_field("application_name")
then
  set_field("vmware_app", to_string($message.application_name));
end

rules.title: vmware app from message
rules.description: ESXi host syslog (Hostd, snmpd, Vpxa, vmkernel, etc) doesn't get application_name parsed because the format is '<host> <app>[pid]?: ...'. Regex out the tag and set vmware_app.
